title: Duration parser input handling
difficulty_rationale: Single module, but several input-validation edge cases (empty input, case, whitespace, ordering, duplicates, bare numbers) interact inside a regex-based parser.
summary: parse_duration() silently accepts malformed strings (empty, repeated or out-of-order units, bare numbers) and rejects valid upper-case or padded input.
required_behavior: Accepted format: one or more <integer><unit> components with units d, h, m, s, in strictly descending order (d before h before m before s), each unit at most once.
Units are case-insensitive; leading/trailing whitespace is ignored; no whitespace is allowed inside the string.
The result is the total number of seconds as an int.
Empty strings, strings with only whitespace, bare numbers without a unit, unknown units, repeated units, out-of-order units, signs and decimals raise ValueError.

acceptance_tests.description: Valid component combinations parse to the right number of seconds.
Upper-case units and surrounding whitespace are accepted.
Empty and whitespace-only input raises ValueError.
A number without a unit raises ValueError.
Units out of descending order raise ValueError.
Signs, decimals, inner spaces and unknown units raise ValueError.
